To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the velocity profile of the jet can be predicted in a self consistent manner from the turbulent dynamics; 2) the velocity profile is independent of the details in the forcing, in the limit of vanishing friction and vanishing energy injection; 3) the Reynolds stress tensor is independent of the forcing, and can be computed from the turbulent dynamics in a self-consistent manner; 4) the maximal curvature of the jet can also be predicted in a similar manner; 5)
the velocity profile and Reynolds stress of a turbulent jet are determined by the forcing at the largest scale and the viscosity at the smallest scales.
